fields.ABOUT: igla-coder-gpu: CPU fine-tune of the 9M tc model on Railway (loop 20), no RunPod key needed. HF TC02 bins -> train.py ckpts (scripts/tc02_to_pt.py, byte gate) -> two arms of remote/cpu_ft.sh -> val.jsonl + exported .tc02. Railway quota is 24 CPUs (nproc lies 48): <=16 torch threads per process. SEED=N [SHUF=0|1] tri tc-cpuft (suffix rule: remote/cpu_ft_env.sh; SHUF=1 default for N>0 = --shuffle_chunks, a real data-order replication) = replication arms, trained AND judged on the 57 catalog items in the same container (remote/cpu_ft_judge.sh): the local uplink cannot ship the 34 MB of bins (loop 21). Ships one file of cpu_ft, never the dir (it holds the local .tc02 bins). Then: tri tc-remote fetch --sub results/t27/cpu_ft results/t27/catalog/sc_cpu_a_sN   results/t27/catalog/sc_cpu_b_sN ; tri tc-remote down
